label: Tropical Storm Koppu (Lando), GFD event 4300
method: S1 VH: Otsu-on-VH + got-darker-vs-dry-baseline change gate + permanent-water + slope + HAND-style flood-plausible-terrain mask

validation.comparison: vs GFD MODIS `flooded` at native 250 m, permanent water removed from both
validation.caveat: The only Sentinel-1 acquisition is several days after GFD onset, and a single 10 m SAR pass is compared to a multi-day 250 m MODIS optical product. Low pixel IoU is the expected, documented limitation of this comparison, not a hidden one. Track A's product is the reproducible, permanent-water-masked observed-extent time series; Track B (event-disjoint) carries the trained-model claim.
